classification: Demonstrated production macOS zombie-process-group behavior, not solely a fixture artifact.
cause: After SIGTERM the unreaped group leader is a zombie; killpg can return EPERM until process.poll reaps the leader.
fix: Reap before signaling; if leader exits during signal race, reap and retry once. Propagate EPERM for live leaders or still-denied groups. Always send final group signal even after leader exits.
before_fix: 2 failed in 10.59s with real 5-second grace and worker readiness handshake.
after_fix: 29 passed, 1 existing macOS non-UTF8 filename skip in 23.25s.
surviving_descendant_test: Real forked child ignored SIGTERM and continued writing; final group SIGKILL stopped child and output writes.
